decisions.reason: The transactional email service builds directly on the firm's core messaging expertise, data centers and own R&D, so the firm can read its results and keep improving it, even though it was not visible on the website in 2020 to 2021.

Email-to-fax conversion relies on long-held channel integration know-how and still serves regulated customers who depend on fax, but fax demand is declining and the product was not visible in 2020 to 2021.
This fax optimization feature is close to the core fax service and cheap to maintain, but it is the most likely to be quietly folded into the base offering as fax volumes shrink.
Sandbox threat protection strengthens the growing email security portfolio, where the firm's security knowledge lets it absorb new threat information and keep refining the product.
Multi-engine virus scanning is a natural extension of the secure messaging service that the firm can operate easily, though it may be merged into a bundled security suite.
